n04.query: Does Self-RAG need its separate critic model at inference, and how is this requirement avoided during training?

sub_queries: Does Self-RAG need its separate critic model at inference?

n04.rewritten_query: Self-RAG separate critic model at inference avoided during training critic requirement
n04.hypothetical_document: Self-RAG typically requires a separate critic model at inference to evaluate retrieval and generation quality. During training, this requirement is avoided by using the critic only to generate reflection tokens that train the main model to critique itself, so no external critic is needed at inference.
